What to send

Good information helps us respond faster.

Email photos of the equipment and nameplates whenever possible.

Include the manufacturer, model or part number, quantity, condition and current location. For switchgear or switchboards, wide photos of the complete lineup and close-ups of nameplates are especially useful.

Purchasing is subject to review; not every item or inventory will qualify.
